intervention: Proposed proactive shipment-exception triage; operational feasibility and queue interference unverified
randomization_unit: customer; first eligible order only; assignment persists
primary_endpoint: Failure to deliver the first eligible order by its promised UTC deadline frozen at assignment; include cancelled and genuinely undelivered orders
estimand: Intention-to-treat treatment-minus-control risk difference among all randomized eligible customers
outcome_policy: Adjudicate after frozen deadline plus 7-day recording lag; missing telemetry remains unknown, never automatically classified as delivery or physical non-delivery
assumption_basis: Illustrative sensitivity grid, not calibrated from Olist delivered-only lateness or current business data
sample_size_method: Equal expected arm sizes, pooled-null/unpooled-alternative normal approximation; ignores far tail and Fisher discreteness
primary_test: two-sided Fisher exact; single primary hypothesis; no optional stopping
risk_difference_interval: Newcombe hybrid Wilson at 1-alpha; not an inversion of the Fisher test
